cases.atomic_claim: Input: consumer code calling Decrypt(message, crypto.Armor, decHandle, nil, callbacks). Expected: it compiles unchanged; Decrypt keeps the exact five-parameter signature with messageEncoding int8 and a verifyHandle parameter that accepts nil.

Input: a concrete type assigned to mime.MIMECallbacks. Expected: it compiles only if it implements exactly OnBody(string,string), OnAttachment(string,[]byte), OnEncryptedHeaders(string), OnVerified(int) and OnError(error); missing or renamed methods fail to satisfy the interface.

Input: a decryptable, parseable PGP/MIME message with two attachments. Expected: the recorded callback sequence is OnVerified/OnError first, then exactly one OnBody, then two OnAttachment calls in MIME order, then a final OnEncryptedHeaders("").

Input: messages exercising each signature outcome. Expected: every OnVerified argument is one of constants.SIGNATURE_OK (0), SIGNATURE_NOT_SIGNED (1), SIGNATURE_NO_VERIFIER (2), SIGNATURE_FAILED (3) or SIGNATURE_BAD_CONTEXT (4), and never any other integer.

Input: a message whose signature cannot be verified. Expected: each error passed to OnError satisfies errors.As(err, *crypto.SignatureVerificationError) and its Status equals the matching constant; a plain fmt.Errorf without the typed cause fails this check.
Input: a decryptionHandle whose Decrypt returns a non-nil error. Expected: Decrypt calls OnError exactly once with that same error and invokes no other callback.

Input: a successful decryption whose bytes are not a readable MIME message (no valid header block). Expected: Decrypt calls OnError with an error whose Error() string begins with the literal "mime: ".

Input: a multipart/signed message whose signed first part has trailing spaces, tabs and CR before each line ending and a valid detached signature. Expected: the signed content is trimmed per line, canonicalized to CRLF, and passed to PGPVerify.VerifyDetached(canonicalBody, signature, crypto.Armor) so verification succeeds; verifying the untrimmed or decoded body fails.

Input: a message where both the embedded OpenPGP signature and the PGP/MIME signature fail. Expected: OnError is called twice (embedded status first, then PGP/MIME status) and OnVerified is called once with max(embeddedStatus, mimeStatus) under SIGNATURE_FAILED (3) > SIGNATURE_NO_VERIFIER (2) > SIGNATURE_NOT_SIGNED (1) > SIGNATURE_OK (0).

cases.surface: mime.Decrypt verifyHandle nil and non-nil behavior
cases.atomic_claim: Input: two otherwise identical messages, one passed a non-nil verifyHandle and one passed nil. Expected: the first produces exactly one OnVerified(constants.SIGNATURE_OK) call; the second produces zero OnVerified calls.

Input: a message whose text/plain body contains the invalid UTF-8 byte 0xFF between ASCII text. Expected: OnBody is called exactly once with the body text in which 0xFF is replaced by U+FFFD and with the part's MIME type string.

Input: a message with two binary attachments in MIME order. Expected: OnAttachment is called exactly twice, each time with the attachment's raw header block string and its fully transfer-decoded bytes, in MIME order.
Input: any successfully parsed message. Expected: OnEncryptedHeaders is called exactly once with the empty string and it is the final callback, after OnBody and all OnAttachment calls.

Input: consumer code that imports github.com/ProtonMail/gopenpgp/v3/mime. Expected: all previously exported identifiers (Decrypt, MIMECallbacks and its methods) still exist with the same signatures and callback behavior; removing or renaming any of them breaks compilation.

Input: `git diff --name-only` against the starting commit. Expected: only mime/mime.go, mime/signature_collector.go, mime/mime_test.go, go.mod and go.sum are listed; edits to crypto/, armor/, constants/, profile/, mobile/ or any other file fail this check.

cases.surface: exported APIs of crypto, armor, constants, profile and mobile
cases.atomic_claim: Input: compiling and testing the crypto, armor, constants, profile and mobile packages. Expected: their exported signatures and observable behavior are unchanged (same test outcomes) and the github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto dependency remains; altering any public symbol of those packages fails this check.

Input: the mime/testdata directory before and after the migration. Expected: every fixture file (for example mime/testdata/mime/scenario_11.asc and mime/testdata/mime_pgpMessage) is byte-identical, so `git diff -- mime/testdata` is empty.

Input: mime/mime_test.go after the migration. Expected: the behavioral assertions on callback values, signature statuses and errors are retained (for example TestMessageVerificationNotSignedFailed still expects OnError statuses 1 and 3 and OnVerified [3]); deleting, skipping, loosening or hardcoding those assertions fails this check.

Input: the collected patch from /workspace/repo. Expected: the change set is an uncommitted working-tree diff against commit 0cb393362a994a485e76cae41e73531a882c55ad and every created or modified file is present in the working tree, not only in a commit or outside the checkout.
